description: Trust anchor for the runner-canary report captures. actions_real.json is real GitHub Actions jobs and check-run annotations for five ci.yml runs of this repository, projected to the fields the report reads by tests/scripts/runner_canary_fixture_projection.py. Tests verify the checksum BEFORE parsing; scenarios mutate disposable copies, never this file.
regenerate: python -m tests.scripts.runner_canary_fixture_projection capture RAW, then project RAW tests/scripts/fixtures/runner_canary/actions_real.json, then recompute this manifest. Only when the report's read set changes, in its own reviewed change.
